2.2. lcf_utils.prettyprint¶

Helper module for emitting RJSON.

Functions

to_rjson(obj[, indentation_level])
return:Pretty printed RJSON for obj.

Classes

PPCommentedItem(comment, item) Pretty printer formatter that can be used to prepend a comment to an item (map, list, literal, etc).
PPList(elems[, inline]) Pretty printer object that gives the user control over how lists are pretty printed.
PPMap(fields[, inline]) Pretty printer object for RJSON maps that gives the user control over the order in which keys are printed.
PPRawString(val[, strict]) Pretty printer of RJSON raw string constants.
PPString(val[, multiline]) Pretty printer of RJSON strings, capable of handling multiline strings.
